message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: Defendant contracted renovation, took 22 million? Actually 22万元 (220,000 RMB) after completing work, left. He owed workers 57,000 RMB labor wages. Labor bureau ordered payment, he escaped and refused to pay. After police case, he paid the owed wages. So the crime is refusing to pay labor remuneration? In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" (refusal to pay labor remuneration). The description: employer refuses to pay wages after labor contract, after being ordered by labor administrative department, and escapes. That's a crime.

Also maybe "逃匿" (fleeing) but not a separate crime. The main crime is "拒不支付劳动报酬". The earlier examples: they used "拒不执行判决、裁定" for refusing to execute judgment. For labor wages, they used "拒不支付劳动报酬". In the earlier example, they had a case: "王某因买卖合同纠纷...未履行判决...拒不执行判决、裁定". That's a different crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: maybe "诈骗"? He took money from client (22万元) but that was legitimate payment for work. He didn't defraud the client; he completed work? He left after receiving payment, but maybe he didn't finish? It says engineering ended, he got 22万元 and left. He owed workers wages. So not fraud.

Thus single charge.
